notes.title: Small update 1.151
notes.notes:
*Due to some problems with the pads in the game, if the player runs out of pills, when reloading his game he will receive:
-Easy: 3 pills
-Normal: 2 pills
-Hard: 1 pill
*The head bobing was also adjusted.

Thank you for reporting bugs in the game.

notes.title: Update 1.15
notes.notes:
-Added directional light on levels.
-Correction of the English language in Chapter 2.
-Improved design and textures of the main player.
-Improvement of the animations of the main player.
-Defense function of the main player.
-New game mechanics. Non-regenerable life and obtaining medical pills.
-Improves the damage effect.
-Improved graphic configuration.
-Improving performance with the use of material instances.
-Disabled Eye Adaptation function, the light will no longer affect the contrast of the camera player.
-Skip of cutscenes.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26076420/4aa185604f2233406a4aa49312bf63d9b17c66a6.jpg
